messages:
Ellen (Design): Noticed a few usability and a11y spikes in the Vectors preview during the design pass. On medium screens the Export button disappears when the relevance inspector expands. Also the preview column makes rows huge. Screenshot attached.
Samir (Frontend): Repro'd at 1366x768. The preview cell is doing a lot of heavy lifting (full vector text). Quick mitigation: collapse preview into a per-row drawer and add a "Pin actions" affordance so Export/Copy stay visible.
Pri (Product): From product POV: we must prevent accidental enormous downloads. Customers once pulled a 300MB CSV and hit pipeline failures. We should estimate compressed size before export and warn if >75MB. Also offer recommended format (CSV vs NDJSON) based on the estimate.
Hector (ML): Technical suggestions: run a server-side estimate that samples rows and extrapolates compressed size, show an estimated compressed size badge (e.g., ~42MB gzipped). For export formats: support CSV, NDJSON, and server zipping with an optional _manifest.json containing {dataset_id,row_count,dim,export_time}. NDJSON avoids CSV quoting problems with long vectors.
Ellen (Design): Copy thoughts: toolbar action should read "Export dataset" (primary). If estimate > threshold show a line: "Recommended: NDJSON for large exports" with a small help link. Checkbox copy: "Include raw vectors (large files)". Modal primary CTA: "Start export"; secondary: "Cancel".
June (A11y): Accessibility checklist: 1) Export modal must be role=dialog with aria-labelledby and initial focus on close button. 2) The pinned actions must be reachable via keyboard and not trap focus. 3) When the estimate recommendation changes (e.g., CSV -> NDJSON) we need aria-live="polite" announcing "Export format recommended: NDJSON (safer for large vectors)". 4) Provide text alternatives for sparklines and color-coded deltas like "+0.12".
Samir (Frontend): Implementation notes: ditch textarea innerText serialization (it truncates). Use streaming Blob downloads or server-side streamed zip. Add an endpoint /estimate-export that returns {format_recommendation, estimated_gzip_bytes}. Frontend shows the badge and disables Start until user confirms if estimate > cap. We'll also add a compact rows toggle and a keyboard shortcut (Shift+R) to toggle it.
Pri (Product): UX flow decision: if estimate > 75MB, require explicit confirmation: modal with size badge and a checkbox "I understand this may be large and could take several minutes" before Start export. For self-serve enforce a soft cap of 20k rows for full-vector CSV and otherwise suggest NDJSON. Enterprise can request higher limits.
Hector (ML): For streaming: server should stream gzip'd NDJSON or CSV rows into a zip with manifest, avoid assembling whole payload in memory. Also include a minimal metrics response after export: rows_streamed, bytes_sent, compressed_bytes. Useful for support.
Ellen (Design): UI follow-ups: 1) Add "Pin actions" toggle in the table header (pin icon + label). 2) Move format selector into the modal with a small explanation tooltip. 3) Put the estimated size badge next to the format selector and also in the toolbar when a dataset is loaded. Ensure focus styles and contrast meet AA.
June (A11y): Also ensure reduced-motion respected for row expand animations, and that the keyboard shortcut list exposes the new shortcuts. I'll volunteer to run a SR+keyboard pass once there's a PR.
Samir (Frontend): I'll open a single PR that: adds /estimate-export, switches client to Blob/stream download fallback, implements compact rows + pin actions, and the confirm modal for large exports. Will include unit tests for very long vectors and NDJSON generation.
Pri (Product): Please add an analytics event when users confirm a large export so we can monitor misuse. Also surface an optional support contact link in the modal for enterprise overrides.
ci-bot: Created ticket UI-5678: "Vectors preview: export compression estimate, pin actions, compact rows, and a11y checks" and attached mockups and repro steps.
